uname: Linux vm 6.18.44-fc-v153 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC @0 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux
policy:
# Policy used by bench/real/run.py for configurations B5 and B6.
# The harness launches foreground and background workloads in these cgroups,
# so classification does not depend on each tool's process names. The
# inversion micro-benchmark runs in /hush-bench/mixed and is classified by
# thread name instead (cgroup rules take precedence over comm rules).

[scheduler]
fg_slice_ms     = 5
normal_slice_ms = 10
bg_slice_ms     = 20
guard_ms        = 2000
boost_ms        = 50
boost_cap_pct   = 10
watchdog_ms     = 30000

[[rule]]
match = { cgroup = "/hush-bench/fg" }
class = "foreground"

[[rule]]
match = { cgroup = "/hush-bench/bg" }
class = "background"

[[rule]]
match = { comm = ["inv_fg", "inv_load", "ctl_loop"] }
class = "foreground"

[[rule]]
match = { comm = ["inv_bg"] }
class = "background"
